constraints: Operates only on a document that is currently open (docRef from a prior Open document/Create document call).
If anchor is omitted, offset is relative to the beginning of the document.
anchor values: 1 = relative to the beginning of the file, 2 = relative to the end of the file, 3 = relative to the current position.

jointConstraints.rule: The sign/range of valid offset values depends on which anchor is chosen (e.g. a negative offset is meaningful when anchored to the end or current position, but not when anchored to the beginning).
